outcome: Meeting Obstetric Care Consensus (OCC) guidelines for nulliparous, term, singleton, and vertex (NTSV) cesarean births
finding: In-house provider coverage, regardless of resident involvement, is associated with increased odds of NTSV cesarean births meeting OCC guidelines.
mod_finding: This study found that in-house provider coverage, regardless of resident involvement, is associated with increased odds of NTSV cesarean births meeting Obstetric Care Consensus guidelines.
